map.Input: 中杯 500 ml、奶茶基底(+30)、全脂牛奶(+80)、全糖(:
Input: medium 500 ml, milk tea base (+30), whole milk (+80), full sugar (100%), add pearls (+80). 
 Base calories = 30 + 80 = 110 kcal; sugar = 500÷100 x (100%÷100) x 10 = 50 kcal; toppings = 80 kcal. 
 Total = 110 + 50 + 80 = 240 kcal. 
 Conclusion: this medium full-sugar pearl milk tea is about 240 kcal (about equal to 50 min brisk walking); no sugar saves 50 kcal, no pearls saves another 80 kcal, dropping to about 110 kcal.
